'''Kishu reeds''' were a type of reed native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. The [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] used kishu reeds as part of a native [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]] ritual in order to prepare for construction of a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]].
